role: The command and player name candidates for the chat GUI's tab completion.
scope_reason: The only consumer is the chat GUI's completion list, which the native client does not have; its command surface is the TCP control port.

members.name: S3APacketTabComplete
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: Sent in reply to the client's tab complete request (NetHandlerPlayServer.java:1103).
